coinIds.title: Coin IDs
coinIds.description: One or more CoinGecko coin IDs (not ticker symbols), e.g. "bitcoin", "ethereum", "solana", "dogecoin". Find the exact ID on a coin's CoinGecko page URL.

vsCurrency.title: Quote currency
vsCurrency.description: The fiat or crypto currency to price against, e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc".
